verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports say Stripe Tax uses customer VAT numbers in automatic calculation and validates them against VIES, but only once with no way to retrigger it, so ongoing compliance re-validation falls to the developer. The docs confirm zero-tax outcomes with a taxability_reason field but never explicitly describe reverse charge or tax ID registry validation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of real-time VAT/tax ID registry validation, explicit reverse-charge documentation, re-validation capability, and coverage of non-EU registries.

support.subject: As a developer, B2B cross-border sales are handled correctly — VAT and tax IDs validated against official registries in real time, reverse charge applied when it should be

citations.quote: Stripe tax does all of that automatically, based on the customer full address and VAT numbers.
Stripe's VIES validation only takes place once and there is no way to retrigger it.
The API returns the reason for a tax result in the taxability_reason field.
